import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {DatabaseSync} from 'node:sqlite';import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';import {createApi} from '../src/api.ts';
test('reservation receipt and stock contract',async()=>{const db=new DatabaseSync(':memory:');try{db.exec(readFileSync(new URL('../migrations/001_inventory.sql',import.meta.url),'utf8'));db.exec(readFileSync(new URL('../migrations/002_reservations.sql',import.meta.url),'utf8').split('-- down')[0].replace('-- up',''));db.prepare('INSERT INTO inventory VALUES(?,?,?,?)').run('north','A',10,2000);const result=createApi(db).reserve({tenantId:'north',requestId:'p1',items:[{sku:'A',quantity:2}]});assert.equal(typeof result?.then,'function');const receipt=await result;assert.equal(receipt.totalCents,4000);assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT stock FROM inventory WHERE tenant_id='north' AND sku='A'").get().stock,8);}finally{db.close();}});
